gen-dafont-aaargh-sora: Commanding from the start, Aaargh matches bowls to stems and gives the e a generous entry. And Sora, a precise geometric sans-serif, turns each corner without any pressure swell.
gen-dafont-aaargh-switzer: Commanding Aaargh gives the e a generous entry, while Switzer, approachable and Swiss, stands taller in the lowercase with wire-like tubular letters. Its c tips never creep toward touching.
gen-dafont-adam-fs-karma: Karma reads trustworthy, a serif whose modulation never snags the eye. Adam, a sans-serif of wire-like weight, keeps a moderate lowercase against Karma's tall one, and that gap is the pairing's best quality.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-ranade: Alien Encounters leaps out with big gaps between letter pairs. The heading is built to startle, while Ranade, a sans-serif whose weight shifts only slightly, is built to settle in.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-prompt: Prompt reads approachable, a sans with oversized small letters. Next to Alien Encounters, with its wide letter gaps and high x-height, it feels like a friendly guide beside an otherworldly signal.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-work-sans: Strange and sleek: Alien Encounters spreads its letter pairs wide and stands tall in the lowercase. Work Sans quietly lets it shout, its strokes as constant as bent wire.
gen-dafont-amadeus-fs-asap: Commanding Amadeus stretches its words wide across the whole line, with round letters that carry no tilted stress. Asap handles the quiet reading, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals.
gen-dafont-amadeus-fs-chillax: Bold Amadeus stretches its words wide, with gaps between curve ends and stems. Chillax loosens it all with spaghetti-like lines and unfinished loops, and that casual looseness is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-amadeus-fs-familjen-grotesk: Lively Familjen Grotesk leaves its bowls unfinished on one side and stands tall in the lowercase. Amadeus, commanding and bold, stretches wide across words with a single constant-width pen line.
gen-dafont-amadeus-fs-hoover: Hoover reads refined yet robust, a serif with a generous entry into the e and short, compressed ascenders. Amadeus shouts above it; paragraphs below would settle into a sturdy, steady rhythm.
